title: Answer a note the agent pinned for you
done: That is it: the agent is told, and goes on as it assumed.

notes.text: Assumed: the slow fixtures can wait for the wake-up.

steps.caption: Instead of stopping to ask, the agent can pin a note to what it concerns, and carry on.
Notes appear in Discuss, with the place they are pinned to.
Each says what the agent assumed. Confirm it, correct it, or dismiss it.
Correct lets you write what is right instead; the agent reads it at its next step.
